scope: Complete eleventh numbered juan: Commentary on the Images, Upper Part, hexagrams 1–30, including source introductory matter. Not the preface or preliminary juan.
word_count_method: Latin-letter tokens, including hyphenated and apostrophized forms, within source-aligned English blocks; footnote references and image markup excluded. Includes attribution and primary-text labels; excludes added section headings, project front matter, and endnotes.
count_note: 213 primary-text blocks represent 212 Image statements. Great Possession's fifth-line Small Image is split into two source paragraphs.

collation.type: selective comparison of transcriptions, with additional internal contextual checks
collation.base: YiXueWang, as archived in the repository
collation.parallel: Wikisource Siku Quanshu transcription, Juan Eleven
collation.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/w/index.php?title=御纂周易折中_(四庫全書本)/卷11&oldid=528597
additional_sources: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/周易傳義附録_(四庫全書本)/卷05上
collation.limitations: Some later parallel-text fetches failed. Contextual repairs in those passages are labeled as such; they are not attributed to an unexamined witness.

review.automated_validation_scope: Source identity, ordered block and primary-Image alignment, role labels, notes, images, and file integrity; not proof of semantic accuracy.
